details: ASTRA is a software-based astronaut health monitoring system designed to help astronauts monitor their health during space missions. Our project provides a digital dashboard that displays important health information such as body temperature, heart rate, and oxygen levels. It helps users understand and keep track of health data through a simple and user-friendly website. Since astronauts work in a challenging space environment, monitoring their health is very important. ASTRA aims to support astronaut safety, improve health awareness, and make space missions safer through technology.
